runtime_failure.failure_point: jax.devices() default backend initialization before DataLoader construction

diagnostic_reproduction.scope: no dataset, no model, no scientific outcomes; JAX client initialization only

case_a.fatal_message: Thread tf_XLATfrtCpuClient creation via pthread_create() failed

root_cause: With default JAX platform discovery on a 256-logical-CPU host, XLA initializes a TFRT CPU client and its large CPU thread pool in addition to the CUDA client. Under the intentionally finite TasksMax=512 scope this crosses the task/thread boundary and aborts before any data or model execution. Explicitly constraining JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda avoids the unnecessary CPU backend and initializes successfully with about 262 threads while preserving the single-A100 training backend.

resource_repair.reason: Restricting backend discovery to CUDA is a host-resource containment choice; the authorized training topology already requires exactly one A100 GPU and does not rely on a CPU JAX device.
